summary: As #digped teachers we have a moral obligation to model criticality when it comes to online platforms. When we keep using tools like @YouTube we are telling our LGBTQ students "You do not matter" Don't choose convenience over what is right.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
As #digped teachers we have a moral obligation to model criticality when it comes to online platforms. When we keep using tools like @YouTube we are telling our LGBTQ students "You do not matter"

Don't choose convenience over what is right.
